purpose: Freeze the exact user-testable Parallel SHA while development and integration continue independently on parallel.
publication_requirements: candidate commit is reachable from parallel
required exact-SHA Build work candidate completed successfully
FINAL_PACKAGE: PASS and candidate provenance/attestation are present for STANDARD
Build parallel economy completed successfully when the ECONOMY profile is intended for this test point
artifact IDs and workflow run IDs are recorded before the pointer is advertised as ready
pointer_rules: parallel-testpoint is a delivery pointer only and is not a development or integration branch
do not build alternative source lineage on parallel-testpoint
do not advance the pointer merely because parallel HEAD advanced
keep the issued pointer frozen while its gameplay result is awaiting evidence unless the user explicitly supersedes it
before advancing, re-read the live pointer and the candidate exact SHA; never force-push an unrelated or non-parallel commit
the updater resolves the desired commit through parallel-testpoint but validates and downloads artifacts produced with head_branch parallel
failure_behavior: if an exact-SHA build was cancelled or failed, do not publish that SHA
if required artifacts or attestations are missing or expired, do not publish that SHA
if a newer parallel commit appears during publication, it does not invalidate an already verified candidate; publication remains tied to the chosen exact SHA
